067d01e fix(ios): Option 2 - use 100dvh layout instead of position:fixed [90m(2025-12-23)[0m
  Option 1 (scroll jiggle) didn't fix scrolling down issue.
  
  Option 2 approach:
  - Layout uses height: 100dvh on mobile (adjusts with iOS keyboard)
  - Main content scrolls internally (overflow-y: auto)
  - Navbar sits at bottom of flex container (no position:fixed)
  - 100dvh automatically handles iOS viewport changes

d43a026 fix(ios): simplify - replace 500 lines with scroll jiggle workaround [90m(2025-12-23)[0m
  The previous approach was overengineered. This simple fix:
  1. When keyboard closes (focusout on input)
  2. Do a tiny scroll jiggle (+1px then back)
  3. This forces iOS to recalculate its viewport
  
  ~500 lines → ~90 lines. Sometimes simple is better.

4951b82 fix(ios): always apply offset in iOS quirk mode, remove vv_offsetTop check [90m(2025-12-23)[0m
  Root cause: vv_offsetTop fluctuates between 0 and >0 during iOS scroll
  animations, causing rapid offset toggling (flickering navbar).
  
  Fix: Once in iOS quirk mode (vv_height < innerHeight by ~68px), always
  apply the 68px offset. This works for both scroll=0 (home indicator
  visible) and scrolled states (navbar lifted into view). The previous
  vv_offsetTop check was the source of the flickering.

8b40576 fix(ios): check vv_offsetTop to determine if offset needed when scrolled [90m(2025-12-23)[0m
  Root cause: After keyboard closes in iOS PWA, when at scroll=0 the
  navbar is visible in the home indicator area (vv_offsetTop=0). But
  when scrolled DOWN, iOS shifts the visual viewport (vv_offsetTop=68)
  and the navbar gets pushed below visible area.
  
  Fix: Check vv_offsetTop - only apply offset when scrolled (offsetTop > 0).
  At scroll=0 (offsetTop=0), CSS safe area handles positioning.

dba4a53 fix(ios): use threshold instead of safe area for keyboard detection [90m(2025-12-23)[0m
  The iOS viewport quirk after keyboard closes is ~68px, not equal to
  safeAreaBottom (34px). Use a 100px threshold to distinguish between
  iOS quirks (should be 0 offset) vs real keyboard/toolbar (needs offset).
94adca7 fix: revert yarn.lock to fix build [90m(2025-12-23)[0m

ce0978c fix(ios): prevent double-compensation for safe area inset [90m(2025-12-23)[0m
  Root cause: After keyboard closes in iOS PWA mode, visualViewport.height
  is 68px smaller than innerHeight due to the home indicator safe area.
  Our calculation saw this as a 68px offset, but CSS already handles
  safe area via paddingBottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom).
  
  Fix: Measure safe-area-inset-bottom and subtract it from the calculated
  offset to prevent double-compensation. When offset equals safe area
  (and keyboard is not active), set offset to 0.
